
---

### How to install

### Option 1: Using web installer (recommended)

1. Visit [kiisu-web-updater.pages.dev](https://kiisu-web-updater.pages.dev/)
2. Choose `Unleashed (Kiisu-UNLSHD)`
3. Select `INSTALL` (or `UPDATE`)

<img width="500" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8288a882-9c6f-41ae-afed-593b32173665" />

<details>
<summary> <h3> Option 2: Using Flipper Lab/qFlipper <h3> </summary>

1. Download **`kiisu-unlshd_XXXXXXXX_dd-MM-yyyy.tgz`** from the assets below
2. Open **qFlipper** or visit [lab.flipper.net](https://lab.flipper.net)
3. Select **Install from file** and choose the downloaded file

</details>

> [!IMPORTANT]
> #### qFlipper, Flipper mobile app, and Flipper Lab might not recognize Kiisu after switching from a different firmware.
> To fix this, just simply **delete all files on the SD card or wipe your SD card and reinstall the firmware** (you can keep captured files or downloaded DB files). **Or wipe your SD card before installing this firmware**.
> Please read the FAQ section in ReadMe if you encounter other problems.

> [!NOTE]
> Flipper mobile app and Flipper Lab might mark this firmware as incompatible. **This is NOT an issue** - please refer to Unleashed firmware issue [#1059](https://github.com/DarkFlippers/unleashed-firmware/issues/1059#issuecomment-5147113914).
>
> Consider using [qUnleashed](https://github.com/DarkFlippers/qUnleashed) instead.

> [!NOTE]
> If somehow qFlipper can't install this version (unknown error, timeout error, etc.), try using [kiisu-web-updater.pages.dev](https://kiisu-web-updater.pages.dev/) or [lab.flipper.net](https://lab.flipper.net/) instead.
